title: rootless: clear environment before spawning pause process
body:
<!-- Please include a concise description of your changes -->
### Description
When spawning the pause process in `pkg/rootless/rootless_linux.c`, the process inherited environment variables from the parent process before setting `_PODMAN_PAUSE=1`. If the parent environment exceeded 4096 bytes (the chunk size read by `is_pause_process`), `_PODMAN_PAUSE=1` was placed beyond the first 4KB chunk, causing `is_pause_process` to treat a healthy pause process as stale and unlink its `pause.pid` file.

This PR calls `clearenv()` before setting `_PODMAN_PAUSE=1` so the pause process only carries the necessary marker at index 0. Additionally, `is_pause_process()` safely null-terminates its read buffer.

Fixes: #29650
Signed-off-by: sundeep8967 <sundeep8967@gmail.com>
